features.title: Modular lockers that grow with you
features.text: Designed for modern offices, Bay Lockers offer secure, scalable, and modern storage. These lockers provide each employee with personal space in today’s agile offices.

features.title: Tamper-proof steel construction
features.text: Start small and scale up, Bay Lockers allow up to four add-on units, giving you flexible storage that evolves with your workspace.

features.title: Dual-door personal storage
features.text: Made from powder-coated steel, Bay Lockers resist tampering and daily wear, giving you dependable personal storage with long-lasting strength.

features.title: Simple & Secure Hasp Lock System
features.text: Each locker unit splits into two lockable sections, offering secure and spacious storage for personal items in shared environments.

features.title: Space-saving locker design
features.text: Space-saving locker designA user-centric solution, hasp locks enable secure storage with personal padlocks, ideal for flexible workplaces.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
